verdict.rationale: Bruno stores API collections as plain-text Bru files that can be versioned in Git and run via CLI/Docker in CI/CD pipelines (bruno-docs-9, bruno-docs-18, bruno-docs-30, bruno-docs-46, bruno-docs-49), which supports a GitOps-style workflow for API *collections*. However, this is API-client/testing config-as-code, not true 'API infrastructure' (gateways, routing/policy config) management — there's no evidence of gateway or infra provisioning capability. Missing for 10: evidence of managing actual API gateway/infrastructure resources (routes, policies, deployments) rather than just request collections, and independent/hands-on validation of CI sync workflows at scale.
